summary: Three independent frontend runs reached the public app and exercised the seeded workout, session summary, overload, rest timer, and editor drag-reorder flows. The requested session-summary regression passed with 600 kg volume, one PR, the PR peso badge, and close-to-home navigation; same-day overload prefill, timer controls, and drag reorder with no legacy arrows also passed. One minor frontend integration/code-quality issue was reported: StoreContext's theme effect emits a React hooks missing-dependency warning during app load. The runs did not perform backend testing because this is intentionally a frontend-only app, and isolated persistence assertions were limited by concurrent shared IndexedDB/browser state.

integration_issues.title: Theme synchronization emits a React hooks dependency warning
integration_issues.steps_to_reproduce: Load the public app and inspect the frontend development log.
integration_issues.expected: The app loads without React hook warnings.
integration_issues.actual: The dev server reports that the theme useEffect has a missing dependency: 'state' at StoreContext.js line 52.
integration_issues.impact: Non-blocking runtime/code-quality warning; theme synchronization remains functional, but the effect dependency contract is ambiguous.

action_items: Correct the StoreContext theme useEffect dependency handling and verify normal app load has no hooks warnings.
checked_and_working: Public app loaded at the configured preview URL with the seeded Inverno Split (PPL) plan, three days, and kg units.

Session-summary regression passed: started A · Spinta, entered 60 kg x 10, completed the set, finished, observed session-summary-dialog with summary-total-volume 600 kg, summary-pr-count 1, summary-exercise-0, and the PR peso badge; summary-close-button returned to the home hash route.
Same-day progressive overload regression passed: after recording a set, restarting the same day showed overload-suggestion and prefilled the first set with the suggested weight and reps.
Rest timer regression passed: completing a set displayed rest-timer-display at 2:00, rest-timer-add-30s changed it to 2:30, and rest-timer-skip removed the timer.
Editor drag reorder regression passed: dragging a seeded exercise via drag-handle changed the visible order, and no legacy up/down controls were present.
Frontend lint checks reported no lint errors in the runs that performed the direct source lint check; no application error elements were observed during the tested flows.
not_reachable: A fully isolated persistence assertion across separate browser contexts was not reliable because the three concurrent testing runs share the app origin and IndexedDB; the requested interactions themselves were exercised successfully.
A separate reload-based assertion of drag-order persistence was not performed; live drag reorder and persistence wiring were exercised.
Backend API testing was intentionally skipped because this is a frontend-only, no-backend IndexedDB/localforage app.
additional_field: Three runs reported no backend testing because the app is intentionally frontend-only. The theme warning was reported by run 1; runs 2 and 3 reported no bugs.
